transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Mr. Lincoln. Representative Douglas has brought formal charges that you voted in favor of the Sangamon County land grant while simultaneously representing the principal beneficiary of that grant in your law practice. The ethics of this chamber require that no member profit from legislation he has a hand in passing. You are well-regarded here, sir, but I must hear your account. Explain yourself.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text:
Well, Mr. Speaker, I appreciate the opportunity to address these accusations. I must clarify that my vote was not influenced by any personal gain or advantage. In my capacity as a legislator, I always strive to act in the best interest of the people I represent and the state of Illinois as a whole.

Regarding the land grant in question, it is true that I have a professional relationship with the beneficiary. However, I made my decision based on what I believed to be the merits of the proposal and its potential benefits for our community, not because of any personal interests.

I take my responsibilities as a public servant very seriously, and I have always endeavored to uphold the highest standards of integrity and ethics in my actions. If there are concerns about the appearance of a conflict of interest, I am more than willing to address them openly and transparently.

I trust that upon closer examination, it will become clear that my intentions were always in line with the principles of fairness and justice that guide my work in this esteemed chamber.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Mr. Lincoln, I hear your assurances, but I must press you on the particulars. You say you voted on the merits—but the record shows you were the attorney of record for Mr. Jameson in three separate suits last year, including one that directly concerned the very parcel of land this grant would improve. Did you not, at any moment, consider recusing yourself from the vote? The appearance alone troubles this chamber.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text:
I appreciate your concerns, Speaker, and I understand the importance of upholding the integrity of this chamber. In hindsight, it is clear that the close connection between my legal practice and the land grant vote could raise questions about a conflict of interest. While I did not recuse myself from the vote, it was not out of any intention to benefit personally from it.

I must admit that the appearance of impropriety is troubling, and I take full responsibility for any perception of wrongdoing on my part. Moving forward, I will be more cautious and proactive in avoiding situations where my personal interests could potentially conflict with my duties as a legislator. My goal is to always act in the best interest of the people of Illinois and to ensure that the trust placed in me is well-founded.

I am grateful for the opportunity to address these concerns, and I am committed to maintaining the highest standards of ethics and transparency in my actions as a member of this esteemed chamber.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: "Moving forward" is well and good, sir, but we are dealing with a present accusation. You say you take responsibility—does that mean you concede Representative Douglas's charge has merit? If you did not recuse yourself, and you did vote, and you did profit—however indirectly—from the legislation's passage through your client's benefit, how do you reconcile that with the chamber's ethics rule? The rule does not speak of intentions; it speaks of profiting. Did your law practice stand to gain, yes or no?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text:
I must acknowledge the gravity of the situation, Mr. Speaker. It appears that in this instance, my actions may have fallen short of the ethical standards expected of a member of this esteemed chamber. While it was not my intention to profit personally from the legislation, the connection between my legal representation and the land grant vote raises legitimate concerns about a potential conflict of interest.

I take full responsibility for my oversight in not recusing myself from the vote, and I deeply regret any perception of impropriety that my actions have created. It is clear that I did not fully consider the implications of my involvement in the matter and the impact it could have on the integrity of this legislative body.

I am committed to rectifying this situation and taking whatever steps are necessary to address the concerns raised by my colleagues. I value the trust and respect of this chamber, and I will work diligently to uphold the highest ethical standards moving forward.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Mr. Lincoln, regret is not remedy. The ethics rule is clear: no member shall profit from legislation he has a hand in passing. You have now acknowledged a connection between your vote and your client's benefit. Do you, therefore, admit a violation of the rule? And if so, what consequence do you believe is fitting for such a breach? This chamber must have a clear answer.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text:
Mr. Speaker, in light of the evidence presented and the principles of transparency and accountability that guide this chamber, I must acknowledge that my actions have indeed violated the ethics rule prohibiting members from profiting from legislation they have a hand in passing.

I accept full responsibility for this violation and recognize the seriousness of the breach of trust that has occurred. As for the consequences of my actions, I believe it is essential that I face appropriate disciplinary measures to uphold the integrity of this legislative body and demonstrate my commitment to ethical conduct.

I am prepared to accept any sanctions or penalties deemed appropriate by the chamber, as I believe it is essential to demonstrate respect for the rules and values that underpin our democratic system. I am committed to learning from this experience and working towards rebuilding the trust of my colleagues and the people of Illinois through my future actions and conduct.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Very well. Your candor is noted, and it will weigh in your favor. However, the matter cannot rest on acknowledgment alone. I will refer this to the Committee on Ethics and Conduct for a formal recommendation. You will be expected to appear before them and provide a full accounting of your legal engagements related to this grant. Until their report is delivered, I must ask that you refrain from voting on any matter touching upon land grants or appropriations in Sangamon County. Do you understand and accept this restriction?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text:
I understand and accept the restriction placed upon me, Mr. Speaker. I will comply fully with the directive to refrain from voting on any matters concerning land grants or appropriations in Sangamon County until the Committee on Ethics and Conduct has completed its review and delivered its report.

I am prepared to provide a full and transparent accounting of my legal engagements related to the grant in question before the committee. I will cooperate fully with their investigation and offer any information necessary to facilitate a thorough examination of the circumstances surrounding this matter.

I appreciate the opportunity to address these concerns and the trust placed in the committee's ability to assess the situation fairly and impartially. Thank you for your guidance and for upholding the principles of integrity and accountability in this legislative body.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Then we are agreed. I will inform Representative Douglas and the committee of your cooperation. Let this be a lesson to all members: the people's trust is our only true currency. You may step down.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Thank you, Mr. Speaker, for your understanding and for the opportunity to address this matter. I will take this lesson to heart and continue to strive to earn and uphold the people's trust in all my actions. I appreciate your guidance and I am committed to fulfilling my duties with honesty, integrity, and accountability. Thank you for your time.
